description: Synthetic English notes. A deterministic smoke corpus for the local embedding runtime, not a measure of full Ask Notes answer quality.

notes.text: The desktop release is scheduled for Friday. Maya owns signing and notarization. We must pass the packaged smoke test before publishing.
Restore a deleted note from the nightly backup in the archive folder. Backups run every evening and retain thirty days of history.
Meeting recordings are transcribed locally. Choose the microphone in Settings, start recording, and stop to generate the transcript.
Water the tomato plants every morning during summer. Add compost to the raised beds and remove weeds weekly.
For lentil soup, saute onions and carrots, add red lentils and vegetable stock, then simmer for twenty minutes.
Semantic search retrieves notes with similar meaning even when the wording differs. The local embedding model produces 384-dimensional vectors.
The train to Edinburgh departs at 09:30 from platform four. Reserve a window seat and bring the railcard.
The sidebar must support keyboard navigation. Arrow keys move between notes, Enter opens the selection, and Home moves to the first item.
The monthly infrastructure budget is 400 dollars. Storage costs 80 dollars, hosting costs 250 dollars, leaving 70 dollars for monitoring.
The running plan includes an easy five kilometre run on Tuesday, intervals on Thursday, and a long run on Sunday.
Git synchronization commits Markdown notes before pulling remote updates. If two people edit the same paragraph, resolve the merge conflict manually.
Cloud summarization sends the selected note text to the configured provider. Local search keeps embeddings and note content on the device.
